title: From Fuzzy to Exact: The Halo Architecture for Infinite-Depth Reasoning via Rational Arithmetic
abstract: arXiv:2601.18702v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The prevailing scaling paradigm of Large Language Models (LLMs) rests on a substrate of "Fuzzy" floating-point arithmetic. To mitigate the inherent instability of this approximate foundation, modern architectures have erected a complex scaffolding of structural and numerical heuristics--Complex Residuals, Pre-RMSNorm, Attention Scaling, and Gradient Clipping--consuming significant compute solely to prevent numerical collapse.   We propose a paradigm shift to the "Exact". We introduce the Halo Architecture, grounded in the Rational Field (Q) and powered by a custom Exact Inference Unit (EIU). To resolve the exponential bit-width growth of rational arithmetic, Halo employs a Dual-Ring Topology that unifies two complementary control mechanisms: (1) The Micro-Ring (Continuum Maintenance), which strictly bounds memory complexity via Diophantine Approximation; and (2) The Macro-Ring (Symbolic Alignment), which enforces logical consistency

translated_title: 从模糊到精确：基于有理数运算实现无限深度推理的Halo架构
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.18702v5 公告类型：替换 摘要：当前大语言模型（LLM）主流的扩展范式建立在“模糊”的浮点运算基础之上。为了缓解这种近似基础的固有不稳定性，现代架构构建了复杂的结构与数值启发式机制——复数残差、Pre-RMSNorm、注意力缩放和梯度裁剪——这些机制仅仅为了防止数值崩溃就消耗了大量计算资源。我们提出向“精确”范式的转变。我们引入了Halo架构，该架构植根于有理数域（Q），并由定制的精确推理单元（EIU）驱动。为了解决有理数运算中位宽指数级增长的问题，Halo采用了双环拓扑，统一了两种互补的控制机制：（1）微环（连续统维护），通过丢番图近似严格约束内存复杂度；（2）宏环（符号对齐），强制逻辑一致性……
tldr: 提出基于有理数域和精确推理单元的Halo架构，通过微环（丢番图近似约束内存）与宏环（符号对齐保证逻辑一致性）的双环拓扑，以精确运算取代模糊浮点运算，摆脱数值稳定技巧并实现无限深度推理。
en_tdlr: The Halo Architecture replaces fuzzy floating-point arithmetic with exact rational arithmetic powered by an Exact Inference Unit, using a Dual-Ring Topology—a Micro-Ring that bounds memory via Diophantine approximation and a Macro-Ring that enforces symbolic logical consistency—to eliminate numerical stabilization heuristics and enable infinite-depth reasoning.
